page_title: Pulse — macOS Menu Bar Stock Tracker

sources.entry: Pulse - Native menu bar market tracker for US, Hong Kong and China stocks, crypto, indices, ETFs and portfolio P&L. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/fatwang2/Pulse) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: Pulse
summary.one_liner: Pulse is a macOS menu bar app that shows stock, crypto and precious metal prices, candlestick charts, and position P&L for multiple markets.
use_cases: Keep stock prices visible in the menu bar while working
Track holdings and today's and total P&L across markets
View intraday and extended-hours candlestick charts
Monitor crypto and precious metal prices
Let AI agents like Claude read and edit watchlists via local MCP
Watch stock prices above the Claude Code prompt
summary.what_it_does: Pulse sits in the macOS menu bar and shows prices, percentage changes and a rotating ticker for stocks across US, Hong Kong, China, Taiwan, Japan and Korea, plus crypto and precious metals. It offers candlestick charts with volume at 5-minute, 15-minute, 30-minute and 1-hour resolutions, and US intraday charts include pre- and post-market sessions. Holdings are tracked with quantity, cost and trades, and a P&L card shows today's and position P&L by market. Watchlists can be organized into multiple named lists, and a local MCP server on 127.0.0.1 lets AI clients read and edit watchlists and positions.
notable: Candlestick charts with volume and extended-hours sessions for US stocks
Position P&L by market with automatic Holdings list
Local MCP server on 127.0.0.1 for AI agents, gated by Keychain token
No account needed; watchlists stored locally on the Mac
caveats: Free 30-day trial, then a one-time purchase of $9.99 early-bird (regular $19.99) through October 31; quotes stop refreshing after trial until purchase
Hong Kong quotes are delayed about 15 minutes and Japanese quotes about 20 with free sources; pushed real-time quotes need a Longbridge OpenAPI account
Does not place trades; for watching only
